messages.author: 92a06be4d96a96ee
messages.subject: coord_ploar and scale_x_continuous issue
parts:
I am plotting a wind rose, and have used this code in the past, but
its no longer working!

rose <- data.frame(direction=sample(0:359, 1e4, replace=TRUE),
magnitude=sample(1:29, 1e4, replace=TRUE))
ggplot(rose,aes(x=direction,fill=cut(magnitude,seq(0,30,5)))) +
geom_bar() +
scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0,360),breaks=c(0,90,180,270)) +
coord_polar()

gives:

Error in data$x[data$x == -Inf] <- range$x.range[1] :
replacement has length zero

However, running the plot without either coord_polar or
scale_x_continuous works fine. Yet the plot:

ggplot(rose,aes(x=direction,fill=cut(magnitude,seq(0,30,5)))) +
geom_bar() +
coord_polar()

is very odd ... it has an NA value marked on the "x-axis" ticks and
many bins show up before 0. My sessionInfo is below.

Any help is appreciated,

Justin
